note: Heart of the Mountain goal profiles for the perk advisor. A profile is WEIGHTS OVER EFFECT STATS (hotm.json effects[].stat), never a perk list, so a tree change is a data edit: a new perk that moves a weighted stat is ranked without touching this file. weight = value of one unit of that stat for this goal, relative to 1 Mining Speed. core = always max first (ranked ahead of fill), fill = worth taking after core, skip = never suggested for this goal. 'target' is the level the recommended tree aims at; progress = sum(min(level, target)) / sum(target). Reasons are short and written from the tooltip effects plus the community wiki's mining guides (facts only, CC BY-NC-SA). The wiki itself notes its HotM guides predate the current tree, so every weight is a judgement and ESTIMATED; the certainty field says so per profile. See docs/features/hotm-perk-advisor.md for the sources behind each profile.

profiles.name: Mithril / Dwarven metals
sources: community wiki: Heart of the Mountain, Mithril mining guide

core.reason: flat +20 speed a level; speed is the bottleneck on mithril
+2 fortune a level = more mithril and powder per block
spread mines neighbouring ore for free
mithril converts to titanium, the valuable drop
+30% speed while aiming at the particle, one token

fill.reason: free powder every day, one token
daily random buff, often speed or 5x titanium
the ability most mithril routes use
+5 speed a level on Dwarven metals
Dwarven-metal fortune, +5 at level 1 (later levels unseen)

skip.reason: hard stone spread; mithril routes avoid hard stone

profiles.name: Gemstone mining (Crystal Hollows)
sources: community wiki: Heart of the Mountain, Gemstone mining guide

core.reason: flat speed applies to gemstones too
+5 speed a level, but only on gemstones: the gem-specific speed
gemstone fortune: more gems per block
general fortune also counts on gems
first 2,500 gems a day: 3x gemstone powder, +150 gem fortune

skip.reason: hard stone spread; gem grinding does not break hard stone
